exact_rules: Apply all frozen point denominators and validity rules first. An undefined point component is NOT_ESTIMABLE or INVALID exactly as registered and cannot enter bootstrap as a numeric value.

For every point-eligible component, its required registered bootstrap slack/deviation array must contain a finite value at every one of the 10000 registered replicate indices. If any required index is absent, null, nonfinite, invalid, or otherwise unformable, the entire component array is incomplete: mark that component and every dependent target, surface, mapping policy, cross-target cell/row, grade, gate, advancement, and claim NOT_ESTIMABLE and emit no numeric interval.

For each family replicate b=0..9999, form the frozen estimable-member set after applying only the family-specific missing-member rules. If any required M_b would be max over an empty estimable set, mark the affected family inference NOT_ESTIMABLE, store no numeric M_b for that index, emit no family quantile/band, and retain the registered 10000-index construction without skipping, redrawing, retrying, compressing, replacing, or shortening it.

A missing component may be omitted from M_b for other descriptive members only where the frozen family-specific rule expressly permits it, with the complete missing-member map. Such omission never reduces a required surface or policy into a smaller passing object.

No missing value is replaced by zero, infinity, a point estimate, another member, a scale floor, or an imputed statistic. Family/member count, RNG state, resample tensor, and replicate indices remain unchanged.

Only T4 row T4_LA_WORKER_D1P50_FC13 may use ZERO_ADDED_BOOTSTRAP, and only after its point-estimate denominator passes; that replicate sets F_auto=0 and F_replica=1 with the registered log. It cannot rescue a failed point denominator or apply elsewhere.
A complete finite constant bootstrap array is not missing and uses the unchanged registered finite scale floor. T7's -infinity randomization-degeneracy convention is not a bootstrap recovery rule.
